steps.name: Large text empty composer
steps.goal: Inspect the bottom composer. Dismiss Apple Account Verification with Not Now if present. Do not tap the field yet.
steps.done: The large text fixture shows the complete Start a task hint on one line, with agent, attachment and microphone controls.

steps.name: Focus expands the field
steps.goal: Tap the Start a task input once without typing.
steps.done: The keyboard is open, and the full What should we work on? hint sits above the composer controls without clipping.

steps.name: Draft grows at larger text size
steps.goal: Type the supplied long draft in the focused composer. Do not send it.
steps.type: One two three four five six seven eight nine ten. One two three four five six seven eight nine ten. One two three four five six seven eight nine ten.
steps.done: The draft is visible in the expanded field. The field grows to three lines, then scrolls. Send and microphone remain below it.
expect: One two three four five six seven eight nine ten. One two three four five six seven eight nine ten. One two three four five six seven eight nine ten.

steps.name: Clearing restores the compact hint
steps.goal: The initial Maestro tap targets the reset button in this fixed iPhone 17 Pro fixture. Inspect the composer after the reset. Do not tap keyboard controls.
steps.done: The keyboard is closed, the draft is empty, and Start a task is visible on one line in the collapsed composer again.
